title: AARO says Go Fast is possibly parallax

tellings.quote: Arrow just came to the all domain anomalous resolution office. We just, you know, we're talking about its director. Uh came out and they said that this is possibly parallax.

plain: The Go Fast video, footage from 2015 off Jacksonville, Florida, that seems to show a small object racing over the water, may be explained by parallax, according to the Pentagon's All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office, the office that now looks into UFO reports. Parallax is a trick of viewpoint, where a moving camera makes a slow object look fast. Michels reports that the office said this, while debating the UFO skeptic Mick West.
